question: The economic reforms were initiated by Narasimha Rao government in:
solution:
The correct answer is __**the 8th five-year plan**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The economic reforms were initiated by the Narasimha Rao government during the **8th five-year plan**.
 
• The 8th five-year plan spanned from **1992 to 1997**.
 
• These reforms aimed at liberalizing the economy, promoting private sector participation, and integrating India into the global economy.
 
• Key measures included deregulation of industries, reduction in import tariffs, and opening up to foreign direct investment (FDI).
 
• The reforms marked a significant shift from the previous socialist policies to a more market-oriented approach.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **economic liberalization** in India was a response to a severe balance of payments crisis that the country faced in 1991.
 
• The reforms were spearheaded by the then Finance Minister **Dr. Manmohan Singh** under the leadership of Prime Minister **P. V. Narasimha Rao**.
 
• The **New Economic Policy** of 1991 included measures such as devaluation of the rupee, disinvestment in public sector enterprises, and tax reforms.
 
• The economic reforms led to a significant increase in India's GDP growth rate and transformed India into one of the fastest-growing economies in the world.
 
• The success of these reforms paved the way for further liberalization and economic policies in subsequent years.
